AccessibleOrganizationDto.description: An organization the caller may act on: their own, one they are a team member of, or one whose brands they edit as a collaborator.

agencyId.description: Id of the owner's agency, to address the /v2/agency-CK/{agencyId} endpoints that the agency permissions of role open. Null when hasAgency is false.

hasAgency.description: Whether the owner of this organization has an agency. Only then do the agency permissions of a role (organizationActions.manageAgencyConfig and manageAgencyClients) apply to it. Always false for type COLLABORATOR, which holds no role.

id.description: Id of the organization, to address /v2/organizations/{organizationId} endpoints or to create a brand in it.

isOwner.description: Whether the caller owns this organization: type is OWNER. Use type instead.

name.description: Display name of the organization: the personalized name if the owner set one, otherwise the owner's billing company. Null when there is neither: the front shows its own default.

ownerId.description: User id of the organization owner. Brands of GET /api/admin/simpleProfiles or GET /v2/settings/brands whose userId equals it belong to this organization.

type.description: How the caller reaches this organization. OWNER: they own it and hold every permission. TEAM_MEMBER: with the permissions of role. COLLABORATOR: they edit some of its brands as a collaborator, with no organization permission; only its collaborators, brands and roles endpoints let them in, on the brands they edit.

AccountDeletionEligibilityDto.description: Whether the authenticated owner's account can be deleted from the app

blockedReason.description: Why the deletion is blocked, absent when it is not. FLOWS_EXTRAS_PENDING: the owner owes Flows extra executions that cannot be settled once the account is gone (an unpaid invoice, a charge still being resolved, one accounting is settling by hand or one whose retry is not due yet) and has to ask support to cancel the account

deletable.description: Whether the account can be deleted from the app right now. A deletion is still refused later when the extras of the current cycle cannot be charged at the deletion itself

AutoTaggingItemDto.description: A post the AI selected in an auto-tagging run.

addedTags.description: Tags the run added that are still live and were not taken off since; deleted ones are left out. For a REMOVED post it is what the last removal took off, not the post's current tags.

contentId.description: Id of the post; the planner post id for PLANNER.

deleted.description: True when the planner post was deleted after the run: it keeps the preview the run stored, has no tags and its undo is skipped. Always false for analytics and competitors.

existedTags.description: Tags the post already had when the run started and still has, live ones only. Neither the ones applied later nor the ones taken off since are here; empty when it had none.

networks.description: Networks the post goes to, sorted.

items.description: Networks the post goes to, sorted.

outcome.description: TAGGED, NOT_TAGGED or REMOVED (its tags were taken off afterwards).

reason.description: Why it was not tagged: TAG_LIMIT, NOT_FOUND, TAGS_DELETED or ALREADY_TAGGED (it already had every chosen tag); absent when tagged.

text.description: The post's text, cut to 300 characters; absent when it has none or the run predates it.

thumbnailUrl.description: Image of the post (CDN URL). It may be absent, or stop working if the post is deleted or the network's link expires.

type.description: Where the post comes from: ANALYTICS, COMPETITORS or PLANNER.

AutoTaggingRemovalDto.description: Outcome of taking off the tags an AI auto-tagging run added.

removed.description: Posts that lost the chosen tags the run added; the tags they had before are kept. They stay TAGGED while they keep a live tag of the run, and become REMOVED otherwise.

skipped.description: Posts left untouched: not selected by the run, already undone, the run added them none of the chosen tags, or the chosen tags it added them were all deleted since.

AutoTaggingRunDto.description: An AI auto-tagging run: what it was asked and, once finished, what it did.

aiSummary.description: Fixed, translated sentence with the posts tagged per included type, in the language of the user who launched it (not AI-generated); absent until it finishes, and for a viewer who cannot see every type of the run, since it counts them all.

Number of selected posts by content type and outcome, only for the types the viewer can see.

status.description: Current flow status. PAUSED_NO_QUOTA and PAUSED_NO_ADDON are set only by the system: the brand owner used up the month's Flows quota, or lost the Flows add-on; it runs again by itself once that is solved. A flow stored ACTIVE that does not run is returned, without storing it, with the status it runs with: once the Flows add-on is enforced (from flowsAddonEnforcementDate on), PAUSED_NO_ADDON or PAUSED_NO_QUOTA until the system stores it; INACTIVE when the account it runs on lacks the FLOWS feature or the flow's template. PAUSED_NO_X_ADDON, never stored: an X flow whose account is not connected to the brand (profileConnected false), stored DRAFT or INACTIVE, while the brand owner has no X add-on (losing the X add-on disconnects X, which drafts the flows); it comes without metrics, and its detail, executions, timeline, switching it on and deleting it answer 403 with title FlowXAddonRequiredException. info.description:
Metricool API

The base URL for all endpoints is: https://app.metricool.com/api

All endpoints require authentication. To identify yourself properly, you must include 3 parameters in all calls

You can add the parameters directly in the request (the only parameter that can be implemented in the header with name X-Mc-Auth is the userToken)

  • userToken: It is a unique authorization code for each user and can be found in the account settings.
  • userId: the user identifier of your Metricool account.
  • blogId: It is the identification number of the brand, this number can be easily found from the browser url

403.description:
A missing plan, add-on or quota comes back with title `Forbidden` and a `detail` string naming the cause; `code` is the HTTP status:

```json
{"status":"FORBIDDEN","code":"403","title":"Forbidden",
 "detail":"The brand owner's plan does not include the Flows add-on. Buy Flows packs to use this feature."}
```

| `detail` | Cause |
|---|---|
| `The brand owner's subscription plan does not include Flows. Upgrade to a paid plan to use this feature.` | The owner of the brand in the request is on the free plan. |
| `The brand owner's plan does not include the Flows add-on. Buy Flows packs to use this feature.` | The brand owner is on a paid plan without Flows packs. |
| `The owner of the brand this flow was created on cannot run it: the brand or that account no longer exists, or the account has no Flows add-on, has Flows disabled, or cannot use the template.` | Switching a flow on: the owner of the brand the flow was created on, which may not be the brand in the request, cannot run it. |
| `The brand owner's Flows executions for this cycle are used up, so the flow cannot be switched on.` | Switching a flow on: that owner's executions for the cycle are used up. |
| `The brand owner's plan does not include the X add-on. Buy an X add-on and reconnect X to use this flow.` | An X flow listed as `PAUSED_NO_X_ADDON`: its X account is not connected to the brand and the brand owner has no X add-on. This one comes with title `FlowXAddonRequiredException` instead of `Forbidden`. |

An agency, integration, white-label alias or Vendasta session gets `Flows is not available for this brand.` for any of these causes: the owner's plan and quota are not shown to end clients.

Other 403 responses: the caller's role on the brand does not allow the action; Flows is disabled for the session, the brand owner or the template (title `Feature Disabled`).

Causes here: the role lacks `VIEW_FLOW` and `EDIT_FLOW`; the brand owner is on the free plan (listing does **not** need the add-on); Flows is disabled.

400.description:
A configuration the backend rejects comes back with title `DomainValidationException` and a `detail` object keyed by code (the codes below); each value is the message, naming the action position (`order`) when it applies. When the same code is raised more than once, its messages are merged into one value separated by spaces:

```json
{"status":"BAD_REQUEST","code":"400","title":"DomainValidationException",
 "detail":{"MISSING_FIRST_DM":"A DM action at position 1 is required to activate the flow"}}
```

Validation runs in phases and stops at the first phase that fails, so fixing one batch of codes may reveal the next.

Phases: structure, then save rules (always, including `DRAFT`), then activation rules (only when `status` is `ACTIVE`).

| Code | Flow types | Meaning and fix |
|---|---|---|
| `INVALID_TRIGGER_STRUCTURE` | All | `triggerConfig` does not match the flow type's schema (a field of the wrong type or, for most flow types, an unknown field). Send the fields documented for the flow type. |
| `INVALID_ACTIONS_STRUCTURE` | All | `actionsConfig` does not match the schema, or `actions` contains a `null` element. |
| `TOO_MANY_ACTIONS` | All | More actions than the flow type allows: 3 for `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, 2 for `X_REPOST_UNPOST`, 1 for the rest. |
| `ACTIONS_NOT_ORDERED` | All | `order` values must be unique and strictly ascending in the `actions` array. |
| `UNRECOGNIZED_ACTION_CONFIG` | All | An action's `order` does not exist for the flow type, or its `config` does not fit the action expected at that position. `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`: 0 reply, 1 first DM, 2 second DM with button. `X_REPOST_UNPOST`: 0 repost, 1 unpost. Other types: 0. |
| `NEGATIVE_DELAY_SECONDS` | All | An action has `delaySeconds` below 0. |
| `DELAY_TOO_LONG` | All | An action has `delaySeconds` above 86400 (24 h). |
| `EMPTY_ACTION_CONFIG` | All | An action has a missing or empty `config` (`{}` is only valid for the hide, repost and unpost actions, which carry no content). |
| `TOO_MANY_POST_COMMENTS` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, `TK_COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` | The reply action has more than 3 `postComments`. |
| `TEXT_TOO_LONG` | All with text | A text exceeds its limit (the message names the field): reply comment 2200 (Instagram) / 150 (TikTok); DM 2000 (Instagram) / 10000 (X); X link 2000; in `X_COMMENT_TO_DM`, message plus a 2-character separator plus link 10000. |
| `INVALID_LINK` | `X_DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `X_COMMENT_TO_DM` | `link` is not an absolute `http`/`https` URL. |
| `MISSING_POST_SCOPE` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, `STORY_WITH_KEYWORD`, `TK_COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, `TK_HIDE_WITH_KEYWORD`, `X_REPOST_UNPOST`, `X_COMMENT_TO_DM` | `triggerConfig.postScope` is required to activate. |
| `UNSUPPORTED_POST_SCOPE` | `X_REPOST_UNPOST` | `PUBLISHED_POSTS` is not supported yet; use another scope. |
| `MISSING_POST_IDS` | `X_REPOST_UNPOST` | Every scope except `ALL_POSTS` needs at least one id in `triggerConfig.postIds`. |
| `MISSING_FIRST_DM` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` | The DM action at `order` 1 is required to activate. |
| `MISSING_DM_TEXT` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, `DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `STORY_WITH_KEYWORD`, `X_DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `X_COMMENT_TO_DM` | The DM (`order` 1 in `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, 0 in the rest) has no `message`, or, except in `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, is missing. In `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` a missing first DM returns `MISSING_FIRST_DM` instead. |
| `URL_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_FIRST_DM` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` | The first DM's `message` cannot contain URLs; put the link in the second DM's button. |
| `INCOMPLETE_BUTTON` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` (`order` 2), `DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `STORY_WITH_KEYWORD` | `buttonText` and `link` must be sent together, or neither. |
| `INVALID_BUTTON_LINK` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` (`order` 2), `DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `STORY_WITH_KEYWORD` | The button `link` is not an absolute `http`/`https` URL. |
| `TEXT_TOO_LONG` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` (`order` 2), `DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `STORY_WITH_KEYWORD`, `X_DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM` | On activation: `buttonText` over 200 or button `link` over 2000 characters; in `X_DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `link` over 2000 characters. |
| `INVALID_LINK` | `X_DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM` | On activation: `link` is not an absolute `http`/`https` URL. |
| `BUTTON_REQUIRES_MESSAGE` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` | The second DM (`order` 2) has a valid button but no `message`. Add the message or remove `buttonText` and `link`. |
| `MISSING_REPLY` | `TK_COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` | The reply action at `order` 0 needs at least one non-blank comment in `postComments`. |
| `MISSING_HIDE_ACTION` | `TK_HIDE_WITH_KEYWORD` | The hide action at `order` 0 is required to activate. |
| `MISSING_REPOST_ACTION` | `X_REPOST_UNPOST` | The repost action at `order` 0 is required (the unpost is optional). |
| `MISSING_ACTION_DELAY` | `X_REPOST_UNPOST` | The repost and unpost actions must include `delaySeconds`. |
| `UNPOST_DELAY_NOT_POSITIVE` | `X_REPOST_UNPOST` | The unpost `delaySeconds` must be above 0: it is counted from the repost. |

Other 400 responses: a body field fails request validation (a required field is missing, `flowType` on create is not a known flow type, or `status` is not a known flow status), with title `ValidationError` and a `detail` object keyed by field name (`{"status":"Invalid flow status 'X'. Valid values are: '...'"}`); `flowType` is a known flow type that has no validator yet; or the social profile is not connected (on create, title `FlowAccountNotConnectedException`; on update, title `FlowProfileDisconnectedException`, whatever the `status` when the flow's own account is not connected to the brand, since the configuration of a flow listed with `profileConnected: false` cannot be edited (its status still changes through `PUT /{id}/status`), and otherwise only when `status` is not `DRAFT`). On create, a `status` of `PAUSED_NO_QUOTA` or `PAUSED_NO_ADDON` returns `SYSTEM_STATUS` (title `DomainValidationException`): only the system sets them. On update, sending one back leaves the stored status as it is and saves only the changes. A `status` of `ACTIVE` on a flow of another account's deleted brand returns `DELETED_BRAND_OF_ANOTHER_OWNER` (title `DomainValidationException`): this brand's account would pay for it. A `status` of `ACTIVE` on an Instagram flow of a brand that no longer has its account connected moves it to this brand when both have the same owner, and otherwise returns `FLOW_BRAND_WITHOUT_ACCOUNT` (title `DomainValidationException`): it runs on that other account's brand, which has to reconnect the account first.

A missing plan, add-on or quota comes back with title `Forbidden` and a `detail` string naming the cause; `code` is the HTTP status:

```json
{"status":"FORBIDDEN","code":"403","title":"Forbidden",
 "detail":"The brand owner's plan does not include the Flows add-on. Buy Flows packs to use this feature."}
```

| `detail` | Cause |
|---|---|
| `The brand owner's subscription plan does not include Flows. Upgrade to a paid plan to use this feature.` | The owner of the brand in the request is on the free plan. |
| `The brand owner's plan does not include the Flows add-on. Buy Flows packs to use this feature.` | The brand owner is on a paid plan without Flows packs. |
| `The owner of the brand this flow was created on cannot run it: the brand or that account no longer exists, or the account has no Flows add-on, has Flows disabled, or cannot use the template.` | Switching a flow on: the owner of the brand the flow was created on, which may not be the brand in the request, cannot run it. |
| `The brand owner's Flows executions for this cycle are used up, so the flow cannot be switched on.` | Switching a flow on: that owner's executions for the cycle are used up. |
| `The brand owner's plan does not include the X add-on. Buy an X add-on and reconnect X to use this flow.` | An X flow listed as `PAUSED_NO_X_ADDON`: its X account is not connected to the brand and the brand owner has no X add-on. This one comes with title `FlowXAddonRequiredException` instead of `Forbidden`. |

A configuration the backend rejects comes back with title `DomainValidationException` and a `detail` object keyed by code (the codes below); each value is the message, naming the action position (`order`) when it applies. When the same code is raised more than once, its messages are merged into one value separated by spaces:

```json
{"status":"BAD_REQUEST","code":"400","title":"DomainValidationException",
 "detail":{"MISSING_FIRST_DM":"A DM action at position 1 is required to activate the flow"}}
```

Validation runs in phases and stops at the first phase that fails, so fixing one batch of codes may reveal the next.

Phases: structure, then save rules (always, including `DRAFT`), then activation rules (only when `status` is `ACTIVE`).

| Code | Flow types | Meaning and fix |
|---|---|---|
| `INVALID_TRIGGER_STRUCTURE` | All | `triggerConfig` does not match the flow type's schema (a field of the wrong type or, for most flow types, an unknown field). Send the fields documented for the flow type. |
| `INVALID_ACTIONS_STRUCTURE` | All | `actionsConfig` does not match the schema, or `actions` contains a `null` element. |
| `TOO_MANY_ACTIONS` | All | More actions than the flow type allows: 3 for `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, 2 for `X_REPOST_UNPOST`, 1 for the rest. |
| `ACTIONS_NOT_ORDERED` | All | `order` values must be unique and strictly ascending in the `actions` array. |
| `UNRECOGNIZED_ACTION_CONFIG` | All | An action's `order` does not exist for the flow type, or its `config` does not fit the action expected at that position. `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`: 0 reply, 1 first DM, 2 second DM with button. `X_REPOST_UNPOST`: 0 repost, 1 unpost. Other types: 0. |
| `NEGATIVE_DELAY_SECONDS` | All | An action has `delaySeconds` below 0. |
| `DELAY_TOO_LONG` | All | An action has `delaySeconds` above 86400 (24 h). |
| `EMPTY_ACTION_CONFIG` | All | An action has a missing or empty `config` (`{}` is only valid for the hide, repost and unpost actions, which carry no content). |
| `TOO_MANY_POST_COMMENTS` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, `TK_COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` | The reply action has more than 3 `postComments`. |
| `TEXT_TOO_LONG` | All with text | A text exceeds its limit (the message names the field): reply comment 2200 (Instagram) / 150 (TikTok); DM 2000 (Instagram) / 10000 (X); X link 2000; in `X_COMMENT_TO_DM`, message plus a 2-character separator plus link 10000. |
| `INVALID_LINK` | `X_DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `X_COMMENT_TO_DM` | `link` is not an absolute `http`/`https` URL. |
| `MISSING_POST_SCOPE` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, `STORY_WITH_KEYWORD`, `TK_COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, `TK_HIDE_WITH_KEYWORD`, `X_REPOST_UNPOST`, `X_COMMENT_TO_DM` | `triggerConfig.postScope` is required to activate. |
| `UNSUPPORTED_POST_SCOPE` | `X_REPOST_UNPOST` | `PUBLISHED_POSTS` is not supported yet; use another scope. |
| `MISSING_POST_IDS` | `X_REPOST_UNPOST` | Every scope except `ALL_POSTS` needs at least one id in `triggerConfig.postIds`. |
| `MISSING_FIRST_DM` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` | The DM action at `order` 1 is required to activate. |
| `MISSING_DM_TEXT` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, `DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `STORY_WITH_KEYWORD`, `X_DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `X_COMMENT_TO_DM` | The DM (`order` 1 in `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, 0 in the rest) has no `message`, or, except in `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD`, is missing. In `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` a missing first DM returns `MISSING_FIRST_DM` instead. |
| `URL_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_FIRST_DM` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` | The first DM's `message` cannot contain URLs; put the link in the second DM's button. |
| `INCOMPLETE_BUTTON` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` (`order` 2), `DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `STORY_WITH_KEYWORD` | `buttonText` and `link` must be sent together, or neither. |
| `INVALID_BUTTON_LINK` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` (`order` 2), `DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `STORY_WITH_KEYWORD` | The button `link` is not an absolute `http`/`https` URL. |
| `TEXT_TOO_LONG` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` (`order` 2), `DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `STORY_WITH_KEYWORD`, `X_DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM` | On activation: `buttonText` over 200 or button `link` over 2000 characters; in `X_DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM`, `link` over 2000 characters. |
| `INVALID_LINK` | `X_DM_KEYWORD_TO_DM` | On activation: `link` is not an absolute `http`/`https` URL. |
| `BUTTON_REQUIRES_MESSAGE` | `COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` | The second DM (`order` 2) has a valid button but no `message`. Add the message or remove `buttonText` and `link`. |
| `MISSING_REPLY` | `TK_COMMENT_WITH_KEYWORD` | The reply action at `order` 0 needs at least one non-blank comment in `postComments`. |
| `MISSING_HIDE_ACTION` | `TK_HIDE_WITH_KEYWORD` | The hide action at `order` 0 is required to activate. |
| `MISSING_REPOST_ACTION` | `X_REPOST_UNPOST` | The repost action at `order` 0 is required (the unpost is optional). |
| `MISSING_ACTION_DELAY` | `X_REPOST_UNPOST` | The repost and unpost actions must include `delaySeconds`. |
| `UNPOST_DELAY_NOT_POSITIVE` | `X_REPOST_UNPOST` | The unpost `delaySeconds` must be above 0: it is counted from the repost. |

Valid values are: '...'"}`); `flowType` is a known flow type that has no validator yet; or the social profile is not connected (on create, title `FlowAccountNotConnectedException`; on update, title `FlowProfileDisconnectedException`, whatever the `status` when the flow's own account is not connected to the brand, since the configuration of a flow listed with `profileConnected: false` cannot be edited (its status still changes through `PUT /{id}/status`), and otherwise only when `status` is not `DRAFT`). On create, a `status` of `PAUSED_NO_QUOTA` or `PAUSED_NO_ADDON` returns `SYSTEM_STATUS` (title `DomainValidationException`): only the system sets them. On update, sending one back leaves the stored status as it is and saves only the changes. A `status` of `ACTIVE` on a flow of another account's deleted brand returns `DELETED_BRAND_OF_ANOTHER_OWNER` (title `DomainValidationException`): this brand's account would pay for it. get.description:
Whoever can read those notes, so a mention never names somebody the note will not reach. On a brand of an agency white-label that also covers the agency team members and the agency end clients. Deleted accounts are excluded. Rejected for sessions that cannot mention (integrator and white-label end clients, Vendasta, anonymous). Requires `fullAccessInbox`, the same permission writing a note needs: a read-only Inbox session can never mention anybody. The whole list is returned: filtering by the typed text is done by the frontend over the loaded list.

To write a mention into the note content, interpolate the entry's `mentionId` and its `name` as `@[<mentionId>|<name>]`.

Use `mentionId` verbatim and never build it from `userId` or `agencyId`/`agencyUserId`: an agency end client has no `userId`, so composing the marker from it produces a marker the server cannot resolve and the mention is silently lost — the note saves, with no error, mentioning nobody.

Use `name` for the label. What is stored is taken from the mentioned account rather than from the request, because the label lives inside the note content and the content is served verbatim to every reader, including sessions that must not see email addresses. A label written beside an id this API cannot resolve is kept as sent, except for an email address, which is reduced to its local part.

get.description:
Calendar and library: whoever can see the brand's posts. On a brand of an agency white-label that also covers the agency end clients. Deleted accounts are excluded. Rejected for sessions that cannot mention (integrator and white-label end clients, Vendasta and the anonymous reviewer). The whole list is returned: filtering by the typed text is done by the frontend over the loaded list.

To write a mention into the note content, interpolate the entry's `mentionId` and its `name` as `@[<mentionId>|<name>]`.

Use `mentionId` verbatim and never build it from `userId` or `agencyId`/`agencyUserId`: an agency end client has no `userId`, so composing the marker from it produces a marker the server cannot resolve and the mention is silently lost — the note saves, with no error, mentioning nobody.

Use `name` for the label. What is stored is taken from the mentioned account rather than from the request, because the label lives inside the note content and the content is served verbatim to every reader, including sessions that must not see email addresses. The targets may span several brands: each brand is authorized on its own, and the caller must be allowed to approve posts (or hold full planner access) on it. Applied best-effort: a post that is not in the reviewer's set, is no longer actionable, or sits in a brand the caller may no longer approve on is reported as a failed result, not a 4xx. NOT_FOUND, NOT_ACTIONABLE and FORBIDDEN are terminal; ERROR is transient and retryable. An empty post list, more than 100 posts, a target missing its brand or post id, or a status other than 'approved' or 'rejected', is a 400 naming the offending field: a malformed list is rejected rather than partly acted on, so a decision is never applied to only part of what was sent. The request is multipart/form-data with four optional parts: 'brandLabel', 'agencyId', 'organizationId' and a 'picture' file part - the same picture contract as POST /v2/media and the profile-picture endpoints. 'organizationId' (from GET /v2/organizations) creates the brand in that organization, under its owner's account and brand limit; it requires manageBrands there and cannot be combined with 'agencyId'. Once the brand exists the image is best-effort: if storing it fails the brand is still created and the response carries no image URL. Maximum upload size 1 MB, and neither side of the source image may exceed 2000 pixels — both are rejections, not automatic downscales.
